mintAuthority.headline: Deposit-backed shares inherit USDC issuance risk; owner, curator and allocator control strategy parameters, while a sentinel can restrict allocations.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: The exact immutable VaultV2 deposit/mint path transfers the required underlying USDC before minting shares; the only other share creation is formula-bound accrued fee shares. Owner/curator can alter strategy allocations and bounded fees but cannot invoke an arbitrary-recipient unbacked share mint or replace this share contract. These local share constraints do not remove Circle issuance authority or borrower credit risk, carried through the USDC parent and strategy positions.
